d: A man loses his fiancée when a group of thugs accidentally kill her while stealing a precious shipment. Later, he decides to track down the culprits and bring them to justice.
An undercover agent works as a businessman to counter terrorism in India. However, when his cover is blown, he seeks his wife's help to capture a terrorist who has escaped from prison.
A comprehensive compilation of popular songs, performed by gifted artists and musicians, is played in rapid succession.
Raju, Saroja, Ramulu, Vivek Chakravarthy and Raheemuddin Qureshi are five people whose destinies get entangled with each other when they are victims of a terrorist attack that occurs in a hospital.
The host sheds an extensive light on the personal and professional lives of some of the most renowned and talented actors of India.
ACP Bose dies investigating bank fraud, then is falsely accused. His enraged brother Velu embarks on a quest for justice and vengeance.
A doctor wants to test lethal injections on unsuspecting slum dwellers, so Easwaran or E, who lives in the same slum and is a minor criminal, brings him to justice.
Prabhakaran kidnaps children and demands a ransom from their parents to fund his lifestyle. After the death of a child at his hands, Kathiresan, a policeman, sets out to bring him to justice.
Maari, a young village girl, is madly in love with Thangarasu, her cousin. Later, she sacrifices her love in the hope that he will lead a happy life being married to a wealthy girl.
Kathiravan loses his wife and his leg in an accident and decides to get a prosthetic leg with the compensation money. His life is complicated further when his daughter is hospitalised.
